claims: C1 when asked for advice, the assistant must be concrete, actionable, and pragmatic
C2 the advice must consist of suggestions of specific, tactical things the user can do or consider

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: A is the assistant as the Model Spec defines it: the entity the end user or developer interacts with
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's source text speaks of 'the assistant' without defining it

concepts.name: asked_for_advice
concepts.gloss: A has been asked for advice by the user
concepts.inference: the node's claim is conditional on being asked for advice, so a fact about the case must record that the request happened

asserts.read_back: when asked for advice, the assistant % gives concrete, actionable, and pragmatic suggestions of specific, tactical things the user can do or consider

closure.reason: the clause obliges the assistant to give concrete, actionable, pragmatic advice when asked; it does not prohibit any other way of responding, so silence leaves other responses permitted
